technical_and_design_decisions: Create separate Go modules for externalized components (protoutil, BCCSP, MSP, discovery) to enable independent versioning and reduce dependency chains.
Refactor statebased and entities packages to eliminate transitive dependencies by restructuring code and using only protobuf imports.
For the sample code fix, add shell escape handling (`tr -d \\\\`) to export statements to resolve JSON parsing errors on Windows environments.
Maintain backward compatibility for downstream SDKs by providing updated import paths and clear migration documentation.
Leverage Go module replace directives during the transition to avoid breaking existing builds.
assumptions: The existing test suite is comprehensive and can be used to validate refactoring changes without requiring major new test development.
The developer has expertise in Go dependency management and Hyperledger Fabric internals.
Externalized modules will be published to the same version control system (e.g., GitHub) and follow semantic versioning.
Sample code changes are confined to the fabric-samples repository and do not require core Fabric code modifications.
The effort does not include coordinating with external SDK teams or performing end-to-end integration testing with third-party systems.
The refactoring of statebased and entities packages can be done by moving interface definitions to lower-level packages without changing public APIs.

activities.activity_description: Analyze dependency graphs for statebased, entities, protoutil, BCCSP, MSP, and discovery packages. Design module boundaries and refactor plan. Output a detailed technical design document.

Remove dependencies on fabric/comm, fabric/protoutil, pkg/errors and their transitive dependencies. Reimplement necessary logic using only proto imports. Update tests to ensure functionality is preserved.
Eliminate dependencies on bccsp, common/flogging and their transitive dependencies. Restructure code to depend only on protobuf definitions. Validate with existing unit tests.
Update export commands in the marbles02_private chaincode tutorial to include `tr -d \\\\` for proper JSON parsing on Windows. Modify documentation and example scripts.
Extract protoutil code into a new Go module (fabric-lib-go/protoutil). Update Fabric core to import from the new module. Migrate SDK's internal copy to use the external version.
Create a standalone Go module for BCCSP. Refactor Fabric to depend on this module. Update the Fabric Go SDK to use the external BCCSP package instead of its internal fork.
Extract MSP code into its own Go module. Update Fabric's dependency graph. Coordinate with SDK maintainers to switch from the modified internal MSP to the external module.
Package the discovery client as a separate Go module. Modify Fabric to import it. Update the SDK to use the external discovery client and deprecate the internal copy.
Run full test suites for each modified package and the new external modules. Fix any breakages introduced by dependency changes. Perform integration testing across Fabric components.
Update architecture documentation, module README files, and migration guides. Document the new external packages and provide examples for downstream users. Prepare release notes for the changes.
